items.title: Government of Alberta uses Claude to find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities across government systems
items.content: Government of Alberta uses Claude to find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities across government systems
items.contentSnippet: Government of Alberta uses Claude to find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities across government systems

summaries.zh: 阿尔伯塔省政府采用Claude来识别和修复政府系统中的网络安全漏洞。该技术帮助自动化检测，加快风险排查与响应速度，从而提升整体防护能力。通过应用Claude，政府能够更高效地处理潜在威胁，确保公共数据与数字服务的安全。
summaries.en: The Government of Alberta is deploying the AI assistant Claude to identify and remediate cybersecurity vulnerabilities across its government systems. This initiative aims to strengthen the province's digital defenses by leveraging AI for proactive threat detection and faster vulnerability patching.

items.summary: 阿尔伯塔省政府采用Claude来识别和修复政府系统中的网络安全漏洞。该技术帮助自动化检测，加快风险排查与响应速度，从而提升整体防护能力。通过应用Claude，政府能够更高效地处理潜在威胁，确保公共数据与数字服务的安全。
